title: Reduce duplication in website season page shells
description: The season detail pages under `website/src/pages/season/[season]/` still repeat the same centered shell, metadata header, bordered stat bar, and list-row surface patterns across `player/[seed].astro`, `match/[matchId].astro`, and nearby pages. Survey those files, rank the overlap, and extract the highest-leverage shared season-detail primitives into shared CSS with explicit names.
